voice.title: Record a voice note
voice.description: Say the hearing, the next date or what to do. We will turn it into drafts for you to confirm.
voice.privacy: Audio stays in India and is deleted after 30 days. The transcript stays.

onboarding.title: Why we need your microphone
onboarding.why: To record the voice notes you make here. Nothing is recorded in the background.
onboarding.retention: The audio file is deleted after 30 days. You can delete a recording at any time.

record.hint: Hold, speak, release. Slide left to cancel.

review.title: Review your note
review.matterSearchPlaceholder: Search by title, party or case number
review.dateHintNote: A hint from this device only. Nothing is created from it.
review.notePlaceholder: Type the date or key line, if you want a hint

saved.online: Saved. We will transcribe it now.
saved.offline: Saved on this device. Will transcribe when you're back online.

denied.title: Microphone access is off
denied.steps: Allow microphone access for this site in your browser settings, then open this again.
denied.body: You can still add an audio file from the capture menu.

unavailable.title: This device can't record here
unavailable.body: Open CauseDeck in a current browser over a secure connection to record.

errors.save: Couldn't save this recording on the device.
errors.full: The device outbox is full. Let uploads finish, then try again.
